characterList.description: A dark-skinned male. Only his hands are visible, holding a red and white pencil and a transparent protractor.
characterList.name: Instructor

content_metadata.description: This video tutorial teaches viewers how to find and calculate True Bearing and Magnetic Bearing on a topographical map.

qAndA.question: What is the specific object used by the instructor to calculate the True Bearing on the map?
What is the mean magnetic declination value used in the video?

qAndA.answer: To ensure accurate alignment of the protractor for measuring the True Bearing.
qAndA.question: Why does the instructor draw a True North line parallel to the longitude lines on the map?

qAndA.answer: Magnetic Bearing = True Bearing + Magnetic Declination.
qAndA.question: What formula is used to calculate the Magnetic Bearing?

qAndA.answer: It creates a sense of understanding and confidence as viewers see the practical application of the concepts.

activities.description: The instructor welcomes viewers to a Geography Mapwork tutorial on True Bearing and Magnetic Bearing.

mood.description: Curious. The title card creates interest and the map appearing suggests the practical nature of the tutorial, prompting curiosity.

narrativeProgression.description: Introduction of the topic – True Bearing and Magnetic Bearing.

scenes.title: Introduction to True and Magnetic Bearing Tutorial

videoEditingDetails.description: Animated title card with geographical elements (globe, notepad, pencil, paper plane).
Topographical map appears in the background as the instructor speaks.

activities.description: Explains how to find True Bearing from one trig beacon to another on a topographical map.
Demonstrates finding the True Bearing using a protractor, highlighting the importance of aligning the protractor with the true north line.
Explains the concept of True Bearing and its accurate measurement using a protractor.

mood.description: Curious, shifting to Content as the demonstration progresses. The explanations and demonstration satisfy curiosity and instill understanding.

narrativeProgression.description: Demonstration of True Bearing calculation on the topographical map.

activities.description: Poses a question about finding True Bearing in the reverse direction between the two beacons.

Demonstrates finding the True Bearing in the reverse direction using the protractor, highlighting the importance of aligning the protractor with the true north line and the angle measurement procedure.

mood.description: Content. The repetition of the process reinforces understanding and adds confidence.

narrativeProgression.description: Repetition of the True Bearing calculation in the opposite direction.

scenes.thematicElements: Geography, mapwork, bearings, practical demonstration, reverse calculation.
scenes.title: Reversal of True Bearing Calculation

activities.description: Explains the concept of Magnetic Bearing and its calculation using the True Bearing and the Magnetic Declination.
Applies the formula "Magnetic Bearing = True Bearing + Magnetic Declination" to calculate the Magnetic Bearing.

mood.description: Content, transitioning to Confident. The introduction of a formula and its application solidifies understanding, leading to a more confident grasp of the concept.

narrativeProgression.description: Introduction of Magnetic Bearing and its calculation.

activities.description: Concludes the video, encouraging viewers to like, share, and subscribe for more tutorials.

mood.description: Neutral, leaning towards Excited. Vibrant visuals add a touch of excitement to a standard call to action.

videoEditingDetails.description: End screen with text overlays prompting viewers to like, share, and subscribe. Background transitions to an abstract visual with bright colors and moving lights.

climax.description: The climax points are when the True Bearing (2:53) and the Magnetic Bearing (8:00) are calculated.

storylines.description: The video is structured around two main storylines: Calculating True Bearing and Calculating Magnetic Bearing, with introductory and conclusion scenes outside these storylines.

content_metadata.title: Geography Mapwork Tutorial on True Bearing and Magnetic Bearing
